description: wmpy-power is a Python hydropower-production model published through the Pacific Northwest National Laboratory 9505 project. It combines facility characteristics with managed streamflow and reservoir-storage time series, first calibrating parameters and then forecasting generation. Its documented output is monthly generation for individual facilities within a region. The model supports long-term electricity planning and climate-impact studies where detailed operating data for every plant are unavailable. Application geography and forecast period are determined by the input fleet and hydrological series. Source code and usage instructions are free on GitHub under BSD-2-Clause. A limitation is that the method prioritises regional generation behaviour and may reproduce individual plants less accurately; input bias and scarce facility data remain relevant. No directly related catalogue record was established. This review inspected the documented calibration and prediction workflow without downloading sample data, fitting parameters or reproducing a regional hydropower forecast.
